lemmas.def_en: (medicine) the process of removing a heavy metal from the bloodstream by means of a chelate as in treating lead or mercury poisoning
1. [I, T] (chemistry) To bind a metal ion firmly to an organic molecule to form a ring-like complex.

examples.en: Certain chemical compounds can chelate heavy metals to treat severe acute poisoning.
examples.zh: 某些化合物可以螯合重金属以治疗严重的急性中毒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chelate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 信笺上方的印刷文字, 印有抬头的信笺
lemmas.def_en: a sheet of stationery with name and address of the organization printed at the top

examples.en: The official contract was printed on high quality company letterhead before signing.
examples.zh: 正式合同在签署前印在了优质的公司抬头信笺上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 letterhead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a block of the earth's crust bounded by faults and shifted to form peaks of a mountain range

examples.en: A dense mist enveloped the rugged peaks of the vast mountain massif.
examples.zh: 浓雾笼罩了这座庞大地块崎岖不平的山峰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 massif 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: work consisting of a piece of metal being machined

examples.en: The technician carefully secured the metal workpiece onto the revolving lathe machine.
examples.zh: 技术员小心翼翼地将金属工件固定在旋转车床上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 workpiece 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a high official in a Muslim government (especially in the Ottoman Empire)

examples.en: The grand vizier advised the young sultan on matters of imperial finance.
examples.zh: 首席大臣就帝国财政事务向年轻的苏丹提出了建议。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vizier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不正当, 不法行为, 坏事, 渎职
lemmas.def_en: wrongful conduct by a public official

examples.en: The mayor faced severe public backlash and was eventually charged with official malfeasance.
examples.zh: 市长面临公众的强烈反对，最终被控犯有职务渎职罪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 malfeasance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (New Testament) disciple of Jesus; traditionally considered to be the author of the first Gospel

examples.en: Levi packed his bags early in the morning and moved to London.
examples.zh: 利瓦伊一大早就收拾好行李，搬去了伦敦。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 levis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 轻率, 轻浮, 不稳定
lemmas.def_en: feeling an inappropriate lack of seriousness

examples.en: Such inappropriate levity during a solemn funeral service was deeply frowned upon.
examples.zh: 在庄严的葬礼上表现出这种不恰当的轻浮令人十分不满。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 levity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 写得过多(或长)；写得过多, 用华丽文体写, 写在...上面
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (computing) To replace existing digital data or files by saving new data in the same location; [I, T] to write in an overly elaborate, wordy style.

examples.en: The system prompted me before allowing the new data to overwrite existing files.
examples.zh: 系统在允许新数据覆盖现有文件之前向我弹出了提示。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overwrite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: servile flattery; exaggerated and hypocritical praise

examples.en: The humble rock star often felt overwhelmed by the endless adulation of fans.
examples.zh: 这位谦逊的摇滚明星常常对粉丝无休止的谄媚奉承感到不知所措。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adulation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a medicated solution used for gargling and rinsing the mouth

examples.en: The doctor advised her to gargle warm salt water for throat relief.
examples.zh: 医生建议她用温盐水漱口以缓解咽喉不适。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ with) To wash the back of your throat with liquid by tipping your head back and blowing air through it without swallowing.

examples.en: The doctor advised her to gargle warm salt water for throat relief.
examples.zh: 医生建议她用温盐水漱口以缓解咽喉不适。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gargle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several low composite herbs of the genera Artemisia or Seriphidium

examples.en: Her heart was filled with wormwood after discovering the bitter, painful truth.
examples.zh: 在发现痛苦残酷的真相后，她的内心充满了无尽的凄苦。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wormwood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being the one previously mentioned or spoken of

examples.en: All parties must strictly adhere to the conditions mentioned in the aforesaid contract.
examples.zh: 各方都必须严格遵守上述合同中所提及的各项条款。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aforesaid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the post or office of legate

examples.en: The foreign legation handled sensitive diplomatic matters prior to the sudden outbreak of war.
examples.zh: 该外国公使团在战争突然爆发前处理了敏感的外交事务。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 legation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 同时用两眼的, 两眼并用的
lemmas.def_en: relating to both eyes

examples.en: Normal binocular vision allows humans to perceive depth and accurate three-dimensional space.
examples.zh: 正常的双眼视觉使人类能够感知深度和精确的三维空间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 binocular 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小而圆的物块, 大丸药
lemmas.def_en: a small round soft mass (as of chewed food)

examples.en: The veterinarian administered a large medicinal bolus to treat the sick cow.
examples.zh: 兽医给这头生病的母牛服用了一大粒药丸进行治疗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bolus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an attendant who carries the golf clubs for a player

examples.en: The experienced golf caddie handed the professional player an appropriate iron club.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的球童递给这位职业选手一根合适的铁杆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caddie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a transparent paperlike product that is impervious to moisture and used to wrap candy or cigarettes etc.

examples.en: She wrapped the colorful gift basket securely in clear, glossy cellophane paper.
examples.zh: 她用透明有光泽的玻璃纸将五彩斑斓的礼品篮包扎牢固。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cellophane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蛹, 茧, 形成阶段
lemmas.def_en: pupa of a moth or butterfly enclosed in a cocoon

examples.en: The caterpillar slowly transformed inside its chrysalis before emerging as a vibrant butterfly.
examples.zh: 毛毛虫在蝶蛹中慢慢蜕变，最终破茧成一只艳丽的蝴蝶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chrysalis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 共同创办人, 共同创始人
lemmas.def_en: one of a group of founders

examples.en: She served as the cofounder of a tech startup that revolutionized digital payments.
examples.zh: 她是一家革新了数字支付技术的初创公司的联合创始人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cofounder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a spicy dish that originated in northern Africa; consists of pasta steamed with a meat and vegetable stew

examples.en: We served the spiced lamb stew over a generous bed of warm couscous.
examples.zh: 我们将风味羊肉炖菜盛在厚厚一层温热的蒸粗麦粉上端上桌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 couscous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 干瘪老太婆, 老母羊
lemmas.def_en: an ugly evil-looking old woman

examples.en: In the fairy tale, a mysterious old crone lived deep inside the enchanted forest.
examples.zh: 在童话故事中，一位神秘的老太婆住在魔法森林的深处。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of science that studies the formation and structure of crystals

examples.en: X-ray crystallography played a crucial role in determining the molecular structure of the protein.
examples.zh: X射线结晶学在确定该蛋白质的分子结构中起到了关键作用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crystallography 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 两月一次的, 每月两次的
lemmas.def_en: occurring twice a month

examples.en: The committee members gather for a bimonthly meeting to review the company’s progress.
examples.zh: 委员会成员每两个月齐聚一次，审查公司的进展情况。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bimonthly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a chronic inflammation of the withers of a horse

examples.en: The patient underwent minor surgery to repair an abnormal fistula in his digestive tract.
examples.zh: 该患者接受了小手术，以修复消化道中的异常瘘管。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fistula 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a ballroom dance in quadruple time; combines short and long and fast and slow steps fixed sequences

examples.en: The couple glided across the polished ballroom floor while dancing an elegant foxtrot.
examples.zh: 那对夫妇跳着优雅的狐步舞，在光洁的舞池地板上轻盈滑过。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foxtrot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: capable of producing hallucinations

examples.en: Certain wild mushrooms contain potent hallucinogenic compounds that can cause severe mental distress.
examples.zh: 某些野生蘑菇含有强烈的致幻成分，可能导致严重的精神混乱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hallucinogenic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (baseball) the person who plays the position of catcher

examples.en: The high wire backstop prevented errant baseballs from hitting the spectators in the stands.
examples.zh: 高高的铁丝挡球网防止了飞偏的棒球击中看台上的观众。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 backstop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: widely separated especially in space

examples.en: The violent earthquake tore the small island asunder, creating a massive new canyon.
examples.zh: 强烈的地震将小岛撕裂开来，形成了一条巨大的新峡谷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 asunder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 骗子, 欺骗, 欺诈

examples.zh: 他把推销员天花乱坠的承诺斥为廉价的商业骗局。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 humbug 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 逾越节的, 复活节的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to Passover or Easter

examples.zh: 教堂唱诗班排练了神圣的赞美诗，为即将到来的复活节庆祝活动做准备。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paschal 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 这位大学教授将他的整个学术生涯都奉献给了著名的亚里士多德学派逻辑研究。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aristotelian 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 他们周末去乡间进行了一次短暂的远足，以逃离城市的喧嚣。

examples.zh: 她从果园采摘新鲜的欧洲酸樱桃，用来烤制传统的果馅饼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 morello 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 基因编辑的飞速发展引发了全球关于现代生物伦理学的紧急争论。

lemmas.def_en: a soprano with a voice between soprano and contralto

examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的女中音歌手以其丰富温暖的音色征服了整个歌剧院。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mezzo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inability to use or understand language (spoken or written) because of a brain lesion

examples.zh: 在严重中风后，他出现了暂时性失语症，连说话都十分吃力。

examples.zh: 中风后，这位失语症患者依靠图片卡来表达需求。

lemmas.def_en: exciting sexual desire

examples.en: In ancient folklore, certain rare herbs were widely believed to possess powerful aphrodisiac qualities.
examples.zh: 在古代民间传说中，人们普遍相信某些稀有草药具有强大的催情功效。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aphrodisiac 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 精湛技巧, 对古董等的爱好

examples.en: The young pianist demonstrated astonishing technical virtuosity during her solo recital last night.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的钢琴家在昨晚的独奏音乐会上展现了令人惊叹的精湛技艺。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 virtuosity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pale soft wood of a tupelo tree especially the water gum

examples.en: Local beekeepers produce exquisite honey from the sweet blossoms of the wild tupelo.
examples.zh: 当地养蜂人利用野生多花紫树的甜美花朵酿造出优质蜂蜜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tupelo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the back side of the neck

examples.en: The mother cat gently picked up her tiny kitten by the scruff of its neck.
examples.zh: 母猫轻轻衔住小猫的后颈把它提了起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scruff 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the work of a sailor

examples.en: Generations of brave men in this coastal town have dedicated their lives to seafaring.
examples.zh: 这座沿海小镇的世世代代勇敢男子都投身于航海事业。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seafaring 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a governor in India during the Mogul empire

examples.en: The wealthy nawab ruled over the vast province during the era of the Mughal Empire.
examples.zh: 莫卧儿帝国时期，那位富有的总督统治着这片广袤的省份。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nawab 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various thermoplastic resins used to make things

examples.en: Wrap the leftover sandwiches tightly in clear saran to keep them fresh until tomorrow.
examples.zh: 把剩下的三明治用保鲜膜紧紧包好，以便保鲜到明天。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 saran 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a nap in the early afternoon (especially in hot countries)

examples.en: Most local shops close in the afternoon so workers can enjoy a quiet siesta.
examples.zh: 大多数当地店铺下午歇业，以便员工享受安静的午休。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 siesta 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a meter fixed to a vehicle that measures and displays its speed

examples.en: He glanced nervous at the speedometer and realized he was driving over the limit.
examples.zh: 他紧张地瞥了一眼速度计，意识到自己已经超速了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 speedometer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 污秽的, 肮脏的, 悲惨的, 可怜的, 卑劣的

examples.en: The abandoned factory was transformed into squalid shelters for hundreds of homeless people.
examples.zh: 废弃的工厂沦为数百名无家可归者肮脏破败的避难所。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 squalid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a mountain lake (especially one formed by glaciers)

examples.en: We reached the mountain summit and admired the crystal-clear water of the isolated tarn.
examples.zh: 我们登上山顶，赞叹那座幽僻高山冰斗湖清澈见底的湖水。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tarn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any binary compound of tellurium with other more electropositive elements

examples.en: Geologists discovered a rare gold telluride deposit deep inside the ancient volcanic rock formation.
examples.zh: 地质学家在古火山岩层深处发现了一处罕见的碲化金矿床。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 telluride 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 便条, 纸条, 纸片
lemmas.def_en: a certificate whose value is recognized by the payer and payee; scrip is not currency but may be convertible into currency

examples.en: During the war, the company paid its workers with paper scrip instead of cash.
examples.zh: 战争期间，公司用纸质代金券而非现金来支付工人工资。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scrip 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a dull hollow sound

examples.en: The compiler generated a helper thunk to delay the evaluation of the complex expression.
examples.zh: 编译器生成了一个辅助形实转换程序，以延迟对复杂表达式的求值。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thunk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a flammable gas obtained by cracking petroleum; used in organic synthesis

examples.en: Chemical plants produce vast amounts of propylene to manufacture various durable plastic everyday products.
examples.zh: 化工厂生产大量丙烯，用于制造各种耐用的日常塑料制品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 propylene 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 底座, 基脚, 柱基, 勒脚
lemmas.def_en: an architectural support or base (as for a column or statue)

examples.en: The bronze statue of the famous general stood firmly atop a carved marble plinth.
examples.zh: 那位著名将军的青铜雕像稳稳立在雕花大理石柱基之上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plinth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 坏事, 恶行, 罪恶
lemmas.def_en: the quality of evil by virtue of villainous behavior

examples.en: The ruthless villainy of the tyrant caused untold suffering across the entire kingdom.
examples.zh: 暴君的残忍恶行给整个王国带来了难以言表的苦难。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 villainy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 困惑, 迷惑, 为难
lemmas.def_en: a situation from which extrication is difficult especially an unpleasant or trying one

examples.en: She found herself in a difficult quandary when both prestigious universities accepted her.
examples.zh: 两所名牌大学同时录取了她，让她陷入了艰难的抉择困境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quandary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a diet excluding all meat and fish

examples.en: She adopted vegetarianism to improve her overall health and reduce her carbon footprint.
examples.zh: 她选择素食主义以改善整体健康状况并减少碳足迹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vegetarianism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fortress established in the southwestern United States by the Spanish in order to protect their missions and other holdings

examples.en: Soldiers guarded the historic presidio to protect the strategic border against potential invasions.
examples.zh: 士兵们驻守在这座历史悠久的要塞，以保卫战略边境免受潜在入侵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 presidio 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 严重的营养不良导致那可怜孩子的瘦弱腹部明显膨胀起来。

the state of being stretched beyond normal dimensions

lemmas.def_zh: 可膨胀的, 可扩张的, 会肿胀的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being distended; able to stretch and expand

examples.en: the stomach is a distensible organ

family_guide.root_logic: 以 distend 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不名誉的, 可耻的, 不出名的
lemmas.def_en: (used of conduct or character) deserving or bringing disgrace or shame; - Rachel Carson

examples.en: The commander faced an inglorious retreat after his flawed battle plan completely failed.
examples.zh: 指挥官的作战计划彻底失败后，面临着一场不光彩的败退。

lemmas.def_en: in a dishonorable manner or to a dishonorable degree

examples.en: his grades were disgracefully low

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inglorious 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 乳头, 小乳头状突起, 丘疹, 小脓疱
lemmas.def_en: (botany) a tiny outgrowth on the surface of a petal or leaf

examples.en: Each tiny taste papilla on your tongue contains several specialized sensory receptor cells.
examples.zh: 舌头上的每个微小味乳头都包含若干专门的感官受体细胞。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or resembling papilla

family_guide.root_logic: 以 papilla 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 声明, 格言, 法官意见
lemmas.def_en: an authoritative declaration

examples.en: The strict coach always reminded his young athletes of the ancient Latin dictum.
examples.zh: 严格的教练总是用那句古老的拉丁格言来提醒年轻运动员。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dictum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 归来的, 亡魂的, 鬼的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or typical of a revenant

examples.en: The ancient folklore warned villagers of a vengeful revenant lurking in the shadows.
examples.zh: 古老的民间传说警告村民，黑暗的阴影中潜伏着复仇的亡魂。

lemmas.def_en: a person who returns after a lengthy absence

examples.en: The ancient folklore warned villagers of a vengeful revenant lurking in the shadows.
examples.zh: 古老的民间传说警告村民，黑暗的阴影中潜伏着复仇的亡魂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 revenant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 热忱, 热情, 情欲, 激情, 灼热
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of strong eagerness (usually in favor of a person or cause)

examples.en: The passionate activist spoke with great ardor about the urgent need for reform.
examples.zh: 这位充满激情的活动家满怀热忱地谈到了迫切需要进行改革。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ardor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the weather in some location averaged over some long period of time

examples.en: Many retired couples choose to move to a warmer clime every winter.
examples.zh: 许多退休夫妇每年冬天都会搬到气候更温暖的地方生活。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clime 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 油煎碎面包片, 烤的碎面包片
lemmas.def_en: a small piece of toasted or fried bread; served in soup or salads

examples.en: He sprinkled a handful of crunchy garlic croutons over the Caesar salad.
examples.zh: 他在凯撒沙拉上撒了一把香脆的大蒜面包丁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crouton 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: minimal meaningful language unit; it cannot be divided into smaller meaningful units

examples.en: The prefix 'un' is a bound morpheme that alters the word's meaning.
examples.zh: 前缀“un”是一个能改变词义的黏着语素。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to morphemes

family_guide.root_logic: 以 morpheme 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 亲族, 血亲亲属, 氏族
lemmas.def_en: a person's brother or sister

examples.en: The genetic study compared health data from each participant and their sib.
examples.zh: 这项基因研究对比了每位参与者与其同胞的健康数据。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sib 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 批发商, 股票经纪人
lemmas.def_en: someone who buys large quantities of goods and resells to merchants rather than to the ultimate customers

examples.en: He worked as a jobber, supplying small retailers with wholesale auto parts.
examples.zh: 他是一名批发商，向小型零售商供应汽车配件。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jobber 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various deciduous or evergreen shrubs of the genus Hydrangea

examples.en: The pink hydrangea bushes in the garden bloom beautifully all summer long.
examples.zh: 花园里粉色的绣球花灌木整个夏天都开得格外美丽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hydrangea 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 痰, 粘液, 粘液质, 迟钝, 冷淡, 沉着, 镇定
lemmas.def_en: apathy demonstrated by an absence of emotional reactions

examples.en: A persistent cough with thick yellow phlegm kept him awake all night.
examples.zh: 伴有浓稠黄痰的持续咳嗽让他整夜无法入睡。

lemmas.def_zh: 粘液质的, (正式)平静的, 不动情的, 不动感情的, 冷漠的, 冷淡的, 迟钝的
lemmas.def_en: showing little emotion

examples.en: Despite the chaotic emergency around him, the phlegmatic doctor remained completely calm and focused.
examples.zh: 尽管周围一片混乱紧急，这位沉着冷静的医生依然十分镇定专心。

lemmas.def_zh: 痰的, 含痰的, 生痰的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by phlegm

examples.en: a phlegmy discharge

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phlegm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the regulation of weights and measures of articles offered for sale

examples.en: The medieval town strictly regulated bread prices according to the royal assize.
examples.zh: 这座中世纪城镇严格按照皇家法令来管制面包价格。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 assize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 梯形, 不规则四边形
lemmas.def_en: a quadrilateral with two parallel sides

examples.en: The teacher asked the students to calculate the total area of the trapezoid.
examples.zh: 老师要求学生们计算出这个梯形的总面积。

lemmas.def_en: resembling a trapezoid

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trapezoid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 劳工, 短工, 马夫, 劳役犯, (土著)警察, 勤杂工
lemmas.def_en: a laborer who is obliged to do menial work

examples.en: He felt treated like a corporate peon who had no voice in decisions.
examples.zh: 他觉得自己像个公司底层苦力，在决策中毫无发言权。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: extremely evil or cruel; expressive of cruelty or befitting hell

examples.en: The professor gave us a fiendish puzzle that took hours to solve.
examples.zh: 教授给了我们一道极其难解的谜题，花了好几个小时才解开。

lemmas.def_zh: 恶魔似, 极坏, 残忍, 凶恶, (非正式)非常聪明, 不简单, 不平凡
lemmas.def_en: as a devil; in an evil manner

examples.en: his writing could be diabolically satiric

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fiendish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone (usually in totalitarian countries) who is assigned to watch over foreign visitors

examples.en: Two burly minders escorted the famous celebrity through the chaotic airport crowd.
examples.zh: 两名身材魁梧的保镖护送这位著名明星穿过混乱的机场人群。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 minder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: impervious to, or not penetrable by, sound

examples.en: They used thick acoustic foam to soundproof the basement for band practice.
examples.zh: 他们用厚实的吸音泡沫对地下室进行隔音，以便乐队排练。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To insulate a room, wall, or studio so sound cannot pass in or out.

examples.en: They used thick acoustic foam to soundproof the basement for band practice.
examples.zh: 他们用厚实的吸音泡沫对地下室进行隔音，以便乐队排练。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 soundproof 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a figure of speech that expresses a resemblance between things of different kinds (usually formed with `like' or `as')

examples.en: The poet used the simile 'as brave as a lion' to describe him.
examples.zh: 诗人用了“勇猛如狮”这个明喻来形容他。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 simile 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a method of writing rapidly

examples.en: She used stenography to record every word spoken during the court hearing.
examples.zh: 她用法庭速记法记录下了法庭听证会上的每一句话。

lemmas.def_en: someone skilled in the transcription of speech (especially dictation)

lemmas.def_zh: 速记的, 利用速记的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or employing stenography

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stenography 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To draw attention away from someone else—especially a fellow actor—by behaving more dramatically or impressively.

examples.en: The young supporting actress managed to upstage the lead with her performance.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的女配角凭借出色的表演成功抢了主角的风头。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 upstage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 愚勇的, 有勇无谋的
lemmas.def_en: marked by defiant disregard for danger or consequences; ; -Macaulay

examples.en: Sailing into the stormy sea in a tiny wooden boat was utterly foolhardy.
examples.zh: 乘一艘小木船驶入暴风雨肆虐的大海完全是有勇无谋。

lemmas.def_zh: 愚勇, 蛮勇, 有勇无谋
lemmas.def_en: the trait of giving little thought to danger

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foolhardy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 讲坛, 演讲台, 演讲, 演讲者
lemmas.def_en: a platform raised above the surrounding level to give prominence to the person on it

examples.en: The guest speaker stepped up to the rostrum and adjusted the microphone.
examples.zh: 特邀演讲人走上讲台，调整了一下麦克风。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rostrum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (often passive) To place a dead body in a tomb, or trap someone beneath collapsed earth or rubble.

examples.en: The sudden massive avalanche threatened to entomb the mountaineers beneath heavy snow.
examples.zh: 突如其来的巨大雪崩眼看要将登山者们深埋在厚厚的积雪之下。

lemmas.def_en: the ritual placing of a corpse in a grave

family_guide.root_logic: 以 entomb 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: failure to reach a minimum required performance

examples.en: If he gets one more flunk, he will lose his academic scholarship.
examples.zh: 如果他再得一次不及格，就会失去他的学术奖学金。

lemmas.def_zh: 失败, 考试不及格, 放弃；使不及格
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ out) (North American informal) To fail an exam, course, or test.

examples.en: If he gets one more flunk, he will lose his academic scholarship.
examples.zh: 如果他再得一次不及格，就会失去他的学术奖学金。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flunk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal) To make a crime or mistake seem less serious and more excusable by explaining special circumstances.

examples.en: Hunger cannot completely extenuate his theft, though it makes it somewhat understandable.
examples.zh: 饥饿并不能完全作为他偷窃的开脱借口，尽管这情有可原。

lemmas.def_en: a partial excuse to mitigate censure; an attempt to represent an offense as less serious than it appears by showing mitigating circumstances

family_guide.root_logic: 以 extenuate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 糖皮质素; 糖皮质激素
lemmas.def_en: a steroid hormone that is produced by the adrenal cortex of animals; affects functioning of gonads and has anti-inflammatory activity

examples.en: The doctor prescribed a synthetic glucocorticoid to reduce the severe joint inflammation.
examples.zh: 医生开了一种合成糖皮质激素来减轻严重的关节炎症。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 glucocorticoid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 狗杂种, 浑蛋（通常指男人）
lemmas.def_en: a person who performs fellatio

examples.en: He muttered that the arrogant cocksucker deserved exactly what he got.
examples.zh: 他喃喃自语，说那个傲慢的浑蛋纯属罪有应得。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cocksucker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a specialist in gynecology

examples.en: She scheduled an annual checkup with her trusted gynaecologist this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上向自己信任的妇科医生预约了年度体检。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or practicing gynecology

examples.en: She scheduled an annual gynaecological examination to ensure her reproductive health.
examples.zh: 她预约了年度妇科检查，以确保自己的生殖健康。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gynaecologist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 罪大恶极的人, 恶棍, 异端
lemmas.def_en: a person without moral scruples

examples.en: The police finally captured the miscreant responsible for the recent neighborhood burglaries.
examples.zh: 警方终于抓获了制造近期社区多起盗窃案的恶棍。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 miscreant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sound of something in rapid motion

examples.en: The gentle whir of the ceiling fan lulled the tired child to sleep.
examples.zh: 吊扇平缓的呼呼声哄着疲惫的孩子入睡。

lemmas.def_zh: 作呼呼声, 发飕飕声；使呼呼响
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] When a fan, motor, or bird's wings whir, they make a continuous, rapid, soft buzzing sound.

examples.en: The gentle whir of the ceiling fan lulled the tired child to sleep.
examples.zh: 吊扇平缓的呼呼声哄着疲惫的孩子入睡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whir 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a blemish on the skin that is formed before birth

examples.en: He has a small, star-shaped birthmark just below his left shoulder blade.
examples.zh: 他的左肩胛骨正下方有一块小小的星形胎记。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 birthmark 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wind blowing opposite to the path of a ship or aircraft

examples.en: The cyclist struggled up the steep hill against a punishing coastal headwind.
examples.zh: 骑手顶着沿海强烈的逆风，吃力地爬上陡峭的山坡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 headwind 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a submissive mental attitude resulting from acceptance of the doctrine that everything that happens is predetermined and inevitable

examples.en: His quiet fatalism made him accept life's hardships without ever offering any complaint.
examples.zh: 他内敛的宿命论让他默默承受生活中的苦难，从无怨言。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to fatalism

examples.en: a fatalist person

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to fatalism

examples.en: He held a fatalist view, believing no effort could alter his predetermined destiny.
examples.zh: 他持宿命论观点，认为任何努力都无法改变预先注定的命运。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fatalism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a long oar that is mounted at the stern of a boat and moved left and right to propel the boat forward

examples.en: She gripped each light wooden scull firmly before pushing away from the riverbank.
examples.zh: 在划离河岸之前，她紧紧握住了每一支轻便的木桨。

lemmas.def_zh: 摇桨者, 划船的人, 比赛用小艇
lemmas.def_en: someone who sculls (moves a long oar pivoted on the back of the boat to propel the boat forward)
1. [I, T] To row a lightweight racing boat using two oars, or propel a boat with a single oar over the stern.

examples.en: She gripped each light wooden scull firmly before pushing away from the riverbank.
examples.zh: 在划离河岸之前，她紧紧握住了每一支轻便的木桨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scull 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the part of the stamen that contains pollen; usually borne on a stalk

examples.en: Pollen grains brushed off the mature anther as the busy bee landed.
examples.zh: 忙碌的蜜蜂落下时，花粉粒从成熟的花药上脱落。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anther 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [地](沿缓坡而下的)徐缓黏滞泥流, 泥流
lemmas.def_en: a landslide of mud

examples.en: Torrential rains triggered a massive mudslide that blocked the main mountain highway completely.
examples.zh: 暴雨引发了巨大的泥石流，将山区主干道彻底堵死。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mudslide 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 难以了解的, 不能预测的
lemmas.def_en: of an obscure nature; ; ; ; - Rachel Carson

examples.en: The detective maintained an inscrutable expression while listening to the suspect's suspicious story.
examples.zh: 听着嫌疑人可疑的叙述，侦探脸上依旧毫无表情，令人捉摸不透。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可预测, 不可解, 不可思议
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being impossible to investigate

examples.en: the inscrutability of the future

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inscrutable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 美好, 准确, 精密, 拘泥细节, 纤细
lemmas.def_en: conformity with some esthetic standard of correctness or propriety

examples.en: There was no time to observe every diplomatic nicety during the sudden crisis.
examples.zh: 在突如其来的危机中，根本没时间顾及每项外交礼节细节。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nicety 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one of two or more integers that can be exactly divided into another integer

examples.en: To simplify the fraction, divide both numbers by their greatest common divisor.
examples.zh: 要化简分数，请用两个数除以它们的最大公约数。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 divisor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 巡视者, 巡逻者, 巡警
lemmas.def_en: a policeman who patrols a given region

examples.en: The vigilant patrolman noticed an open side door during his midnight rounds.
examples.zh: 警惕的巡警在午夜巡逻时注意到一扇虚掩的侧门。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 patrolman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the second period of the Stone Age (following the eolithic)

examples.en: Archaeologists unearthed several paleolithic stone tools buried beneath the ancient cave floor.
examples.zh: 考古学家在这座古老洞穴的地面下发掘出了几件旧石器时代的石器。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paleolithic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a pensive lyrical piece of music (especially for the piano)

examples.en: She played a delicate Chopin nocturne on the grand piano late that evening.
examples.zh: 那天深夜，她在三角钢琴上弹奏了一首优美的肖邦夜曲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nocturne 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the prevention of disease

examples.en: Dentists recommend routine oral cleanings as an essential prophylaxis against gum disease.
examples.zh: 牙医建议进行常规口腔清洁，作为预防牙龈疾病的重要手段。

lemmas.def_en: capable of preventing conception or impregnation

examples.en: Doctors recommend regular exercise as a prophylactic measure against heart disease.
examples.zh: 医生建议将规律运动作为预防心脏病的一种措施。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prophylaxis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To start a car with a dead battery using jumper cables from another vehicle; to give a sluggish economy or project an immediate boost.

examples.en: The committee proposed fresh tax incentives to jumpstart the sluggish regional economy.
examples.zh: 委员会提出了新的税收优惠措施，以推动停滞的区域经济复苏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jumpstart 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a short news announcement concerning some on-going news story

examples.en: A sudden television newsflash interrupted the evening broadcast to report the breaking scandal.
examples.zh: 突然插入的电视简讯中断了晚间节目，播报这一突发丑闻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 newsflash 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (literary) When a bell knells, it rings slowly and solemnly to announce a death or funeral.

examples.en: The heavy iron church bell knelled mournfully across the fog-shrouded quiet village.
examples.zh: 沉重的铁制教堂钟声在雾气笼罩的寂静村庄中哀伤地鸣响。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 knell 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (used with singular count nouns) colloquial for `not a' or `not one' or `never a'

examples.en: We searched the entire warehouse, finding nary a trace of the stolen merchandise.
examples.zh: 我们搜查了整个仓库，却连失窃货物的一丝踪迹都没找到。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a skilled worker whose job is to repair things

examples.en: The appliance repairman fixed our leaking washing machine in less than an hour.
examples.zh: 家电修理工在不到一小时内就修好了我们漏水的洗衣机。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 repairman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 精选的, 罕见的, 珍奇的
lemmas.def_en: lavishly elegant and refined

examples.en: The boutique offers a recherche collection of rare vintage accessories.
examples.zh: 这家精品店提供精选的珍奇复古配饰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 recherche 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone (physician or clergyman) who substitutes temporarily for another member of the same profession

examples.en: Dr. Evans is working as a locum at the clinic this month.
examples.zh: 埃文斯医生本月在这家诊所担任临时替班医生。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 locum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: to break off a military action with an enemy

examples.en: The government announced a phased pullout of troops from the region.
examples.zh: 政府宣布从该地区分阶段撤军。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pullout 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 常备步兵, 线路保养工, 边线裁判员
lemmas.def_en: official (in tennis, soccer, football, etc.) who assists the referee in some way (especially by watching for out of bounds or offside)

examples.en: The linesman raised his flag to signal an obvious offside offense.
examples.zh: 边线裁判举旗示意明显越位犯规。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 linesman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the root of the mandrake plant; used medicinally or as a narcotic

examples.en: Ancient herbalists believed mandrake roots possessed powerful medicinal and mystical properties.
examples.zh: 古代草药医生认为曼德拉草根具有强大的药用和神秘力量。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mandrake 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a timepiece that can be started or stopped for exact timing (as of a race)

examples.en: The coach checked his stopwatch as the runner crossed the line.
examples.zh: 运动员冲过终点线时，教练看了一眼秒表。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stopwatch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 裂缝, (堤、坝等的)决口, 崩溃处
lemmas.def_en: a deep fissure

examples.en: The mountaineer narrowly avoided falling into a deep, snow-covered crevasse.
examples.zh: 登山者险些掉进一个被积雪覆盖的深裂缝中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crevasse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 勒颈, 压制自由, 抑制, 束缚
lemmas.def_en: complete power over a person or situation

examples.en: The major tech company tightened its stranglehold on the digital market.
examples.zh: 这家科技巨头进一步加强了对数字市场的垄断控制。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stranglehold 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 越野赛马, 障碍赛马, 越野赛跑, 阻障赛跑
lemmas.def_en: a footrace of usually 3000 meters over a closed track with hurdles and a water jump

examples.en: She trained rigorously for months to win the Olympic steeplechase event.
examples.zh: 为了赢得奥运会障碍赛跑项目的冠军，她刻苦训练了数月。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 steeplechase 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a salt or ester of sulphuric acid

examples.en: Many consumers prefer shampoos that are completely free of harmful sulphates.
examples.zh: 许多消费者更喜欢完全不含危害性硫酸盐的洗发水。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sulphate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 烟幕, 掩盖某人真实意图的东西
lemmas.def_en: (military) screen consisting of a cloud of smoke that obscures movements

examples.en: His polite apology was merely a smokescreen to hide bad intentions.
examples.zh: 他礼貌的道歉只不过是掩盖不良意图的烟幕。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 smokescreen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a system consisting of a generator and a motor so connected that the motor will assume the same relative position as the generator; the generator and the motor are synchronized

examples.en: The technician adjusted the synchro unit to ensure accurate positional data.
examples.zh: 技术人员调整了同步机装置以确保精确的位置数据。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 synchro 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: abnormally rapid heartbeat (over 100 beats per minute)

examples.en: Excessive caffeine intake can trigger sudden episodes of severe sinus tachycardia.
examples.zh: 摄入过多咖啡因可能会引发突发性严重窦性心动过速。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tachycardia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 罗望子, 罗望子的果实
lemmas.def_en: long-lived tropical evergreen tree with a spreading crown and feathery evergreen foliage and fragrant flowers yielding hard yellowish wood and long pods with edible chocolate-colored acidic pulp

examples.en: This traditional curry sauce uses sour tamarind paste for authentic flavor.
examples.zh: 这种传统咖喱酱使用酸罗望子酱来营造地道风味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tamarind 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: typewritten matter especially a typewritten copy of a manuscript

examples.en: The author submitted the finalized typescript of her novel to the publisher.
examples.zh: 作者向出版社提交了她小说的最终打字稿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 typescript 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large carnivorous bipedal dinosaur having enormous teeth with knifelike serrations; may have been a scavenger rather than an active predator; later Cretaceous period in North America

examples.en: The museum unveiled a massive, well-preserved skeleton of a young tyrannosaurus.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了一具保存完好的大型幼年霸王龙骨架。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tyrannosaurus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小于一般尺寸的, 不够大的, 小型的
lemmas.def_en: smaller than normal for its kind

examples.en: The fishermen were legally required to throw back any undersized catches.
examples.zh: 渔民被依法要求放回捕获的所有尺寸不足的鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 undersized 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 人员不足的, 人手不足的
lemmas.def_en: inadequate in number of workers or assistants etc.

examples.en: The hospital emergency room was severely understaffed during the holiday weekend.
examples.zh: 节日周末期间，医院急诊室的人手严重不足。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 understaffed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不畏惧的, 不退缩的, 不畏缩的
lemmas.def_en: not shrinking from danger

examples.en: The documentary provides an unflinching look at the harsh realities of war.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片毫不畏缩地展现了战争的残酷现实。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unflinching 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: basically shredded cabbage

examples.en: The grilled fish tacos are served with a side of spicy slaw.
examples.zh: 烤鱼卷饼配有一份辛辣风味的酸卷心菜丝。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slaw 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: optical device that helps a user to find the target of interest

examples.en: He peered through the camera viewfinder to frame the mountain landscape.
examples.zh: 他透过相机取景器观察，为这幅山地风光取景。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 viewfinder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any market fish--edible saltwater fish or shellfish--except herring

examples.en: The chef prepared freshly caught whitefish seasoned with lemon and herbs.
examples.zh: 厨师用柠檬和香草精心烹调了新捕捞上来的白鲑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whitefish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a strong worktable for a carpenter or mechanic

examples.en: Hand tools and loose screws were scattered across the wooden workbench.
examples.zh: 手工工具和散落的螺丝钉凌乱地堆在木质工作台上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 workbench 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to whales and dolphins etc

examples.en: Marine biologists monitored the cetacean population migrating southward along the rocky coastline.
examples.zh: 海洋生物学家监测了沿着岩石海岸线向南迁徙的鲸目动物种群。

lemmas.def_en: large aquatic carnivorous mammal with fin-like forelimbs no hind limbs, including: whales; dolphins; porpoises; narwhals

examples.en: Marine biologists monitored the cetacean population migrating southward along the rocky coastline.
examples.zh: 海洋生物学家监测了沿着岩石海岸线向南迁徙的鲸目动物种群。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cetacean 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the fleshy part of the human body that you sit on

examples.en: He acted like a complete prat by spilling coffee all over his desk.
examples.zh: 他把咖啡洒得满桌都是，表现得像个彻头彻尾的傻瓜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 洛可可式的, 旧式的, 俗丽的
lemmas.def_en: having excessive asymmetrical ornamentation

examples.en: The palace ballroom was decorated with ornate mirrors and gilded rococo carvings.
examples.zh: 宫殿宴会厅装饰着华丽的镜子和镀金的洛可可式雕刻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rococo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the state of something that has been unused and neglected

examples.en: The old railway line slowly fell into disuse after the new highway opened.
examples.zh: 新公路开通后，这条旧铁路线逐渐被废弃不用了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disuse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: Ideal Voltage Amplifier理想电压放大器；Inspection Visual Aid 检查用观察用具；Intra-Vehicular Activity （航天飞机）舱内活动
lemmas.def_en: any of various coarse shrubby plants of the genus Iva with small greenish flowers; common in moist areas (as coastal salt marshes) of eastern and central North America

examples.en: The engineer designed a circuit using an ideal voltage amplifier to minimize distortion.
examples.zh: 工程师设计了一个使用理想电压放大器的电路以最大程度减少失真。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 iva 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 褐砂石, 褐砂石建筑
lemmas.def_en: a reddish brown sandstone; used in buildings

examples.en: They bought a charming brownstone townhouse on a quiet street in Brooklyn.
examples.zh: 他们在布鲁克林一条安静的街道上买了一栋迷人的褐砂石联排住宅。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brownstone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: agreement of results or opinions

examples.en: Modern software frameworks improve performance by managing database concurrency with great efficiency.
examples.zh: 现代软件框架通过高效管理数据库并发性来提高性能。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 concurrency 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to abdominal delivery

examples.en: The doctor decided that an emergency cesarean section was necessary for safety.
examples.zh: 出于安全考虑，医生决定有必要进行紧急剖腹产手术。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cesarean 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an orange isomer of an unsaturated hydrocarbon found in many plants; is converted into vitamin A in the liver

examples.en: Carrots and sweet potatoes are rich sources of beta carotene and essential vitamins.
examples.zh: 胡萝卜和红薯富含β-胡萝卜素和必需维生素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carotene 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a long overcoat with a hood that can be pulled over the head

examples.en: The traveler wrapped his wool capote tightly against the harsh winter wind.
examples.zh: 旅行者紧紧裹住他的毛呢连帽长大衣以抵御刺骨的冬风。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 capote 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 石灰质的; 含钙的
lemmas.def_en: composed of or containing or resembling calcium carbonate or calcite or chalk

examples.en: Certain marine organisms build protective shells using calcareous deposits from the surrounding water.
examples.zh: 某些海洋生物利用周围水域中的石灰质沉积物来构建保护壳。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 calcareous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to abdominal delivery

examples.en: Historical records describe ancient Roman leaders who possessed grand caesarean authority and ambitions.
examples.zh: 历史记载描述了拥有宏大帝国权威与野心的古罗马领袖。

lemmas.def_zh: 凯撒的；皇帝的；剖腹产的
lemmas.def_en: relating to abdominal delivery

examples.en: The doctor performed an emergency caesarian delivery when complications suddenly arose during labor.
examples.zh: 分娩过程中突发并发症时，医生进行了紧急剖宫产手术。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caesarean 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (载货火车的)守车, 轮船上的厨房
lemmas.def_en: the area for food preparation on a ship

examples.en: A bright red caboose brought up the rear of the long freight train.
examples.zh: 一节鲜红色的守车挂在长长的货运列车末尾。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caboose 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a hard brittle candy made with butter and brown sugar

examples.en: She drizzled warm butterscotch syrup over two large scoops of vanilla ice cream.
examples.zh: 她把温热的奶油糖浆淋在两大勺香草冰淇淋上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 butterscotch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or associated with the bronchi

examples.en: A persistent bronchial infection made it extremely difficult for the singer to breathe.
examples.zh: 持续的支气管感染让这位歌手呼吸极为困难。

lemmas.def_en: either of the two main branches of the trachea

examples.en: The doctor examined the patient's right bronchus using a small flexible camera.
examples.zh: 医生用一根柔软的微型内窥镜检查了患者的右支气管。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bronchial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: showing empathy or ready comprehension of others' states

examples.en: A good therapist must maintain an empathic understanding of the client's emotional struggles.
examples.zh: 一名优秀的治疗师必须对来访者的情感挣扎保持同理心式的理解。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 empathic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of an eye) reddened as a result of locally congested blood vessels; inflamed

examples.en: His eyes were red and bloodshot after staring at computer monitors all night.
examples.zh: 盯了一整晚电脑屏幕后，他的眼睛又红又布满血丝。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bloodshot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large dark-colored food fish of the Atlantic coast of North America

examples.en: Whale watchers spotted a pod of blackfish swimming near the rocky coastline yesterday.
examples.zh: 观鲸者昨天在岩石海岸附近发现了一群黑鲸在游弋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blackfish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: strong woody fibers obtained especially from the phloem of from various plants

examples.en: Ancient craftspeople used bast fibers from local trees to weave strong ropes and baskets.
examples.zh: 古代手工艺人利用当地树木的韧皮纤维编织结实的绳索和篮子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bast 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an alloy of tin with some copper and antimony; a lining for bearings that reduces friction

examples.en: The novel satirizes a complacent babbitt who cares only about wealth and social conformity.
examples.zh: 这部小说讽刺了一个只在乎财富和因循守旧的庸俗商人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 babbitt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: at or in or to any place; ; (`anyplace' is used informally for `anywhere')

examples.en: I lost my apartment keys and cannot find them anyplace in the house.
examples.zh: 我丢了公寓钥匙，在屋里任何地方都找不到它们。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anyplace 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 奉告祈祷, 奉告祈祷钟
lemmas.def_en: the sound of a bell rung in Roman Catholic churches to announce the time when the Angelus should be recited

examples.en: The clear bell chimed softly across the village to signal the evening angelus.
examples.zh: 清脆的钟声在村庄上空轻柔回响，宣告晚间奉告祈祷的开始。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 angelus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: hypersensitivity reaction to the ingestion or injection of a substance (a protein or drug) resulting from prior contact with a substance

examples.en: Severe peanut allergies can trigger acute anaphylaxis if immediate medical treatment is delayed.
examples.zh: 如果不立即进行医疗救治，严重的坚果过敏会引发急性过敏性休克。

lemmas.def_en: related to the hypersensitivity known as anaphylaxis

examples.en: The child suffered a severe anaphylactic reaction after accidentally eating a peanut.
examples.zh: 这名儿童在误食花生后出现了严重的过敏性休克反应。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anaphylaxis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the ratio of reflected to incident light

examples.en: Melting sea ice significantly reduces Earth's albedo, which accelerates the global warming process.
examples.zh: 海冰融化显著降低了地球的反照率，从而加速了全球变暖进程。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 albedo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a female confidant

examples.en: She always turned to her closest confidante whenever she needed honest advice.
examples.zh: 每当需要诚恳的建议时，她总会向自己最亲密的闺蜜倾诉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 confidante 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 太古的, 远古的, 无法追忆的
lemmas.def_en: long past; beyond the limits of memory or tradition or recorded history

examples.en: The nomadic tribe has inhabited these rugged mountains from time immemorial.
examples.zh: 这个游牧部落自远古以来就居住在这些险峻的山区。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 immemorial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a film or TV program presenting the facts about a person or event

examples.en: Critics complain that modern television news has degraded into cheap infotainment.
examples.zh: 批评人士抱怨现代电视新闻已经退化为廉价的信息娱乐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 infotainment 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 保证, 保证品, 抵押
lemmas.def_en: a collateral agreement to answer for the debt of another in case that person defaults

examples.en: The signed agreement acts as a legal guaranty for the business loan.
examples.zh: 这份签署的协议作为该项商业贷款的法律担保。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 guaranty 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cubes of meat or seafood cooked in hot oil and then dipped in any of various sauces

examples.en: We gathered around the bubbling cheese fondue on a cold winter night.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的冬夜，我们围坐在热气腾腾的芝士火锅旁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fondue 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 直到此时, 此时以前, 迄今
lemmas.def_en: used in negative statement to describe a situation that has existed up to this point or up to the present time

examples.en: The scientist unveiled a heretofore unknown species discovered deep within the rainforest.
examples.zh: 这位科学家展示了一种迄今在雨林深处发现的未知物种。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heretofore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being flexed (as of a joint)

examples.en: The physical therapist gently guided the patient's leg through full flexion.
examples.zh: 理疗师轻柔地引导患者的腿部完成充分的屈曲动作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flexion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a card game in which players bet against the dealer on the cards he will draw from a dealing box

examples.en: Gamblers crowded around the saloon table to try their luck at faro.
examples.zh: 赌徒们挤在酒馆的桌子周围，想在法罗牌戏中试试手气。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 faro 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or concerning this

examples.en: The parties hereto agree to abide by the explicit terms hereof.
examples.zh: 本协议各方同意遵守本文件的明确条款。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hereof 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (philosophy) a 20th-century philosophical movement chiefly in Europe; assumes that people are entirely free and thus responsible for what they make of themselves

examples.en: His novel deeply explores existentialism and the painful search for personal meaning.
examples.zh: 他的小说深刻探讨了存在主义以及寻找个人意义的痛苦过程。

lemmas.def_en: a philosopher who emphasizes freedom of choice and personal responsibility but who regards human existence in a hostile universe as unexplainable

examples.en: As an existentialist, he believed that each individual must actively forge their own meaning.
examples.zh: 作为一名存在主义者，他认为每个人都必须积极创造属于自己的意义。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 existentialism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a salt or ester of hydriodic acid

examples.en: The doctor prescribed potassium iodide to protect her thyroid from radiation damage.
examples.zh: 医生开了碘化钾以保护她的甲状腺免受辐射伤害。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 iodide 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 罗唆的, 口头的, 多言的
lemmas.def_en: using or containing too many words

examples.en: The editor advised him to cut the wordy introduction to improve flow.
examples.zh: 编辑建议他删减冗长罗唆的引言以提升行文流畅度。

lemmas.def_en: boring verbosity

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wordy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: characterizing the family Hominidae, which includes Homo sapiens as well as extinct species of manlike creatures

examples.en: Anthropologists discovered ancient hominid fossils that provide clues about our distant ancestors.
examples.zh: 人类学家发现了古老的人科动物化石，为研究我们遥远的祖先提供了线索。

lemmas.def_en: a primate of the family Hominidae

examples.en: Anthropologists discovered ancient hominid fossils that provide clues about our distant ancestors.
examples.zh: 人类学家发现了古老的人科动物化石，为研究我们遥远的祖先提供了线索。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hominid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 番红花属, 番红花, 磨粉
lemmas.def_en: any of numerous low-growing plants of the genus Crocus having slender grasslike leaves and white or yellow or purple flowers; native chiefly to the Mediterranean region but widely cultivated

examples.en: The vibrant purple crocus is often the first flower to blossom after winter.
examples.zh: 鲜艳的紫色番红花往往是冬去春来后第一批盛开的花朵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crocus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 起草者, 制图员, 图案工
lemmas.def_en: a skilled worker who draws plans of buildings or machines

examples.en: The skilled draftsman carefully prepared the architectural blueprints for the new library.
examples.zh: 这位熟练的制图员为新图书馆仔细绘制了建筑蓝图。

lemmas.def_en: the creation of artistic pictures or diagrams

examples.en: he learned drawing from his father

family_guide.root_logic: 以 draftsman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: massive thick-skinned herbivorous animal living in or around rivers of tropical Africa

examples.en: A massive hippopotamus submerged itself in the muddy river to escape the heat.
examples.zh: 一头巨大的河马潜入泥泞的河水中以躲避酷热。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hippopotamus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 压碎, 镇压, 使咯吱咯吱响；咯吱咯吱响, 涉水而过
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To stop or crush a rumor, protest, or idea completely. 2. [I] (+ through) To walk through thick mud or wet shoes making a wet sucking sound.

examples.en: The administration acted quickly to squelch rumors regarding the sudden CEO resignation.
examples.zh: 管理层迅速采取行动，以平息关于首席执行官突然辞职的谣言。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 squelch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an ascetic Muslim monk; a member of an order noted for devotional exercises involving bodily movements

examples.en: The spinning dervish entered a trance-like state during the sacred ritual dance.
examples.zh: 旋转的托钵僧在神圣的仪式舞蹈中进入了出神状态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dervish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an ancient unit of length based on the length of the forearm

examples.en: The ancient text described a magnificent temple measuring one hundred cubits long.
examples.zh: 古文献记载了一座长达一百肘尺的宏伟神庙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cubit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] When keys, bells, or nerves jangle, they make a harsh, discordant metallic ringing sound or feel severely irritated.

examples.en: The loud ring of keys began to jangle his already frayed nerves.
examples.zh: 那串钥匙刺耳的叮当声开始刺激他本就紧绷的神经。

lemmas.def_en: like the discordant ringing of nonmusical metallic objects striking together

examples.en: She carried a large, jangly ring of brass keys in her deep coat pocket.
examples.zh: 她在大衣的深口袋里装了一大串丁当作响的黄铜钥匙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jangle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 易延展的, 韧性的, 易教导的
lemmas.def_en: easily influenced

examples.en: Copper is an extremely ductile metal that can be easily pulled into wire.
examples.zh: 铜是一种延展性极高的金属，很容易被拉成细丝。

lemmas.def_zh: 延展性, 粘性, 可塑性, 可锻性, 韧性, 柔顺, 驯良
lemmas.def_en: the malleability of something that can be drawn into threads or wires or hammered into thin sheets

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ductile 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a musical composition for voices and orchestra based on a religious text

examples.en: The choir performed a moving Bach cantata during the Sunday morning service.
examples.zh: 唱诗班在周日晨礼期间演奏了一首感人至深的巴赫康塔塔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cantata 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fastener that is inserted into holes in two adjacent pieces and holds them together

examples.en: He inserted a wooden dowel to reinforce the joint of the chair.
examples.zh: 他插入一根木销子以加固椅子的接合处。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dowel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无害的, 不触犯人的, 不讨厌的
lemmas.def_en: not causing anger or annoyance

examples.en: He made an inoffensive comment to break the awkward silence in the meeting room.
examples.zh: 他在会议室里说了句无伤大雅的话以打破尴尬的沉默。

lemmas.def_en: in a not unpleasantly offensive manner

examples.en: that wretched beast, the elephant, breathing inoffensively not a pace behind me

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inoffensive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 收敛性的, 严厉的, 涩的
lemmas.def_en: sour or bitter in taste

examples.en: The lotion has an astringent effect that helps tighten pores and reduce oiliness.
examples.zh: 这款乳液具有收敛效果，有助于收缩毛孔和减少出油。

lemmas.def_zh: 收敛性, 涩味, 严厉
lemmas.def_en: a sharp astringent taste; the taste experience when a substance causes the mouth to pucker

family_guide.root_logic: 以 astringent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a minute epidermal pore in a leaf or stem through which gases and water vapor can pass

examples.en: Each stoma on the leaf surface regulates gas exchange and prevents excessive water loss.
examples.zh: 叶片表面的每个气孔都调节着气体交换并防止水分过度流失。

lemmas.def_zh: 气孔的, 有气门的, 气门的, 有气孔的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or of the nature of or having a mouth or mouthlike opening

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stoma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: extravagant self-praise

examples.en: Despite his proud vaunt about winning, he finished last in the cross-country race.
examples.zh: 尽管他曾自夸一定会赢，最终却在越野赛中垫底。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal / literary) To boast or brag proudly about one's achievements or qualities.

examples.en: Despite his proud vaunt about winning, he finished last in the cross-country race.
examples.zh: 尽管他曾自夸一定会赢，最终却在越野赛中垫底。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vaunt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sleep disorder characterized by sudden and uncontrollable episodes of deep sleep

examples.en: Patients suffering from narcolepsy often fall asleep suddenly during normal daytime activities.
examples.zh: 患有嗜睡症的病人经常在白天的正常活动中突然入睡。

lemmas.def_en: a person who has narcolepsy

family_guide.root_logic: 以 narcolepsy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (literary) To fade away and disappear gradually like mist or smoke.

examples.en: The morning mist began to evanesce as the warm sunlight spread across the valley.
examples.zh: 随着温暖的阳光洒满山谷，晨雾开始逐渐消散。

lemmas.def_en: the event of fading and gradually vanishing from sight

examples.en: the evanescence of the morning mist

lemmas.def_zh: 逐渐消失的, 容易消散的, 短暂的
lemmas.def_en: tending to vanish like vapor

examples.en: evanescent beauty

family_guide.root_logic: 以 evanesce 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 咩咩叫；以颤抖的声音说
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] When a sheep, goat, or calf bleats, it makes its characteristic wavering cry; (disapproving) to complain weakly.

examples.en: The lost lamb began to bleat pitifully until its mother appeared nearby.
examples.zh: 迷路的小羊开始哀怨地咩咩叫，直到它的母亲出现在附近。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bleat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: leader

examples.en: Mussolini took the title of Duce to emphasize his absolute authority over Italy.
examples.zh: 墨索里尼采用“领袖”这一头衔，以强调他对意大利的绝对统治权。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 duce 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the uninflected form of the verb

examples.en: In English grammar, an infinitive typically consists of the word 'to' followed by a verb.
examples.zh: 在英语语法中，不定式通常由单词“to”后接动词构成。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or formed with the infinitive

examples.en: infinitival clause

family_guide.root_logic: 以 infinitive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sister who has only one parent in common with you

examples.en: She invited her stepsister to stay for the weekend to build a closer relationship.
examples.zh: 她邀请继姐妹周末来小住，以建立更亲密的关系。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stepsister 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: air-breathing arthropods characterized by simple eyes and four pairs of legs

examples.en: The scorpion is a dangerous arachnid that prefers dark, dry places beneath rocks.
examples.zh: 蝎子是一种危险的蛛形纲动物，喜欢藏在岩石下阴暗干燥的地方。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arachnid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (medicine / biology) To turn a structure, eyelid, or organ inside out.

examples.en: The surgeon had to evert the eyelid carefully to inspect the hidden foreign object.
examples.zh: 外科医生不得不小心地翻转眼睑，以检查隐藏的异物。

lemmas.def_en: the position of being turned outward

examples.en: the eversion of the foot

family_guide.root_logic: 以 evert 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 空的, 空虚的, 没有思想的
lemmas.def_en: devoid of intelligence

examples.en: The interviewer was frustrated by the politician's vacuous smile and lack of real answers.
examples.zh: 政客空洞的微笑和缺乏实质内容的回答让采访者十分沮丧。

lemmas.def_zh: 直愣愣地, 没有表情地；空虚地, 空地
lemmas.def_en: in a vacuous manner

lemmas.def_zh: 空虚, 空白, 愚蠢, 茫然若失, 无意义的事
lemmas.def_en: the absence of matter

examples.en: The vacuity of modern reality television often leaves thoughtful viewers frustrated.
examples.zh: 现代真人秀电视节目的空洞乏味常让深思的观众感到失望。

lemmas.def_zh: 空虚, 无聊, 愚蠢
lemmas.def_en: indicative of or marked by mental vacuity and an absence of ideas

examples.en: the vacuousness of her face belied her feelings

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vacuous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: blood cells that engulf and digest bacteria and fungi; an important part of the body's defense system

examples.en: A high leukocyte count usually indicates that the immune system is fighting an infection.
examples.zh: 白细胞计数偏高通常表明免疫系统正在对抗感染。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leukocyte 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 野蛮的, 残暴的, 粗野的
lemmas.def_en: (of persons or their actions) able or disposed to inflict pain or suffering

examples.en: The international community strongly condemned the barbarous treatment of prisoners during the war.
examples.zh: 国际社会强烈谴责战争期间虐待战俘的残暴行径。

lemmas.def_zh: 野蛮的, 语言不规范的, 残暴的, 粗俗的
lemmas.def_en: in a barbarous manner

examples.en: they were barbarously murdered

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barbarous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of champagne) extremely dry

examples.en: We toasted the anniversary with a chilled bottle of crisp, refreshing brut champagne.
examples.zh: 我们用一瓶冰镇的干型香槟干杯，庆祝这个纪念日。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brut 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a straight sword with a narrow blade and two edges

examples.en: The duelist drew his slender rapier and adopted a defensive fencing stance.
examples.zh: 决斗者拔出他那细长的双刃长剑，摆出了击剑防守姿态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rapier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a channel occupied (or formerly occupied) by a river

examples.en: During the severe summer drought, the dried riverbed cracked under the scorching sun.
examples.zh: 在严重的夏季干旱中，干涸的河床在烈日下开裂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 riverbed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 海军军官候补生, 海军军官学校学生
lemmas.def_en: a temporary rank held by young naval officers in training

examples.en: The young midshipman stood proudly on the deck during his first military training voyage.
examples.zh: 年轻的海军士官生在第一次军事训练航行中骄傲地站在甲板上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 midshipman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a strong north wind that blows in France during the winter

examples.en: A freezing mistral blew down from the north, clearing the sky over Provence.
examples.zh: 一股严寒的密史脱拉风从北方吹来，吹净了普罗旺斯上空的天空。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mistral 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: leavened bread baked in a clay oven in India; usually shaped like a teardrop

examples.en: The toddler ran excitedly into the kitchen to give her naan a warm hug.
examples.zh: 蹒跚学步的孩子兴奋地跑进厨房，给了奶奶一个温暖的拥抱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 naan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无邪的行为；天真烂漫（等于naivete）
lemmas.def_en: lack of sophistication or worldliness

examples.en: Her apparent naivety made her an easy target for seasoned con artists.
examples.zh: 她显而易见的单纯使她很容易成为老练骗子的目标。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 naivety 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: belonging to some prior time

examples.en: The onetime champion struggled to keep up with the younger players.
examples.zh: 这位曾经的冠军如今难以跟上年轻选手的步伐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 onetime 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of a leaf shape; egg-shaped with the broader end at the base

examples.en: The plant can be recognized by its broad, glossy ovate leaves.
examples.zh: 这种植物可以通过其宽阔、有光泽的卵形叶子来辨认。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ovate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 壮观, 华丽, 虚饰, 露天历史剧
lemmas.def_en: a rich and spectacular ceremony

examples.en: The royal wedding was celebrated with immense traditional pomp and pageantry.
examples.zh: 这场皇室婚礼在盛大传统的盛典与壮观场面中举行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pageantry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 平行, 对应, 类似, 比拟
lemmas.def_en: similarity by virtue of corresponding

examples.en: The poet used structural parallelism to emphasize the contrast between the characters.
examples.zh: 诗人运用结构上的对仗来强化人物之间的对比。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 parallelism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a star with 5 points; formed by 5 straight lines between the vertices of a pentagon and enclosing another pentagon

examples.en: A mysterious pentagram was carved into the wooden floor of the attic.
examples.zh: 阁楼的木地板上刻着一个神秘的五角星图案。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pentagram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wood of any poon tree; used for masts and spars

examples.en: The local carpenters prefer using poon wood for durable boat construction.
examples.zh: 当地木匠更喜欢使用胡桐木来建造坚固耐用的船只。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 poon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 拘守礼仪的人, 故作正经的人
lemmas.def_en: a person excessively concerned about propriety and decorum

examples.en: Nobody invited him to the party because he acted like such a prude.
examples.zh: 没人邀请他参加聚会，因为他表现得太古板正经了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prude 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a garment (coat or sweater) that has raglan sleeves

examples.en: She bought a comfortable raglan coat that allowed great freedom of movement.
examples.zh: 她买了一件舒适的插肩袖大衣，活动起来非常自如。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 raglan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (variant spelling of align) To place things in a straight line or bring into agreement.

examples.en: Make sure to aline the edges carefully before gluing the boards together.
examples.zh: 在将木板粘在一起之前，一定要仔细将边缘对齐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aline 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: by repute; according to general belief

examples.en: This secluded mountain cabin was reputedly built by a famous hermit.
examples.zh: 据传这座僻静的山间小屋是由一位著名的隐士建造的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reputedly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 十字架, 十字架上的基督像
lemmas.def_en: representation of the cross on which Jesus died

examples.en: A large carved stone rood hung prominently above the church altar.
examples.zh: 教堂祭坛上方醒目地悬挂着一个巨大的雕刻石制十字架。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ over/into) To throw, hit, or kick a ball or object high in a slow, curved arc.

examples.en: lob the tennis ball

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lobed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 充分满足, 过分满意, 使厌腻
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal, often passive) To satisfy an appetite or desire completely, sometimes to the point of excess.

examples.en: The lavish five-course dinner was enough to sate everyone's appetite completely.
examples.zh: 这顿丰盛的五道菜晚餐足以彻底填饱每个人的胃口。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a unit of perceived loudness equal to the loudness of a 1000-hertz tone at 40 dB above threshold

examples.en: A sound level of one sone equals the loudness of forty phons.
examples.zh: 一宋的声音强度等于四十方法线的响度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sone 为核心的派生词族。
